blocks.text: BANGKOK – Thai Customs officials have seized more than 3,000 electronic cigarettes and Kpods, valued at nearly 3 million baht ($89,000), in a joint operation aimed at preventing the illegal products from reaching young people in three north-eastern provinces. The seizure was announced on Oct 31 by Chong Chom Customs House, which oversees Customs enforcement in Nakhon Ratchasima, Buri Ram and Surin. Officials worked with the Nakhon Ratchasima Mail Centre to inspect domestic postal parcels to intercept smuggled and untaxed goods.
